verdict.rationale: Smithery's Triggers docs once described consumers activating event subscriptions through Smithery, with the MCP server POSTing events straight to the consumer. Two things undercut this. First, Smithery itself only proxied the subscribe call and was not in the delivery path. Second, the first-party shutdown notice says the Smithery API, Connect and SDKs stopped working on 2026-10-31 and the docs tree was removed, so the product no longer offers a working webhook subscription capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
